subject: [PATCH 3/4] mm/madvise: skip zone device folios in cold/pageout PMD range

2026-07-28.patch_summary: This patch modifies the madvise_cold_or_pageout_pte_range function to skip zone device folios in cold/pageout PMD range, preventing them from being aged or reclaimed prematurely. The existing guards do not cover all cases of zone device memory, leading to potential issues with device-coherent THPs. By explicitly skipping ZONE_DEVICE folios, the patch addresses this problem and ensures correct behavior for these types of mappings.
